title: Reactivity-Informed Machine Learning for Performance Prediction and Design Space Exploration of Alkali-Activated Slag
abstract: arXiv:2606.06765v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Establishing quantitative relationships among mix design, raw material properties, curing conditions, and performance remains a long-standing challenge in cementitious materials, particularly for alkali-activated materials with variable precursor and activator chemistry. Here, we curated the largest literature-derived alkali-activated slag (AAS) dataset to date, comprising over 3100 compressive strength records, 155 chemically distinct ground granulated blast-furnace slags (GGBSs), and 24 attributes incorporating precursor chemistry, fineness, and reactivity. Multiple machine learning (ML) algorithms were benchmarked across progressively enriched feature scenarios, demonstrating that integrating GGBS compositions, fineness, curing conditions, and specimen geometry improves predictive performance. translated_title: 基于反应活性的机器学习用于碱激发矿渣的性能预测与设计空间探索
translated_abstract: 在胶凝材料领域，建立配合比设计、原材料性能、养护条件与性能之间的定量关系一直是一项长期存在的挑战，对于前驱体与激发剂化学成分多变的碱激发材料而言尤为如此。在此，我们整理了迄今为止最大的源自文献的碱激发矿渣（AAS）数据集，包含超过3100条抗压强度记录、155种化学成分各异的粒化高炉矿渣（GGBS），以及24个涵盖前驱体化学成分、细度和反应活性的属性。我们在特征逐步丰富的多种情景下对多种机器学习（ML）算法进行了基准测试，结果表明整合GGBS化学成分、细度、养护条件与试件几何形状能够提升预测性能。金属氧化物平均解离能（AMODE）作为前驱体反应活性的一种物理可解释表征，提供了一种……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了迄今最大的碱激发矿渣文献数据集（含3100余条抗压强度记录和155种化学成分各异的GGBS），并引入物理可解释的反应活性描述符（金属氧化物平均解离能）结合机器学习，实现了碱激发矿渣性能的准确预测与配合比设计空间的高效探索。
en_tdlr: The study curates the largest literature-derived alkali-activated slag dataset to date and incorporates a physically interpretable reactivity descriptor (average metal oxide dissociation energy) into machine learning, enabling accurate performance prediction and efficient design space exploration for alkali-activated slag.
